wikipediaTitle: Dancing with the Stars (American TV series) season 35

_notes.multiDancePolicy: Zach decided 2026-10-02: average (mean of the permanent-judge totals of each dance, each out of 30, so a perfect week = full value). Other options: flag, sum, first.
_notes.absentJudgePolicy: Zach decided 2026-10-02: scale (one permanent judge absent -> remaining total x 30/20). Option: flag. Two or more absent is always flagged.
_notes.aliases: Optional overrides: "<couple label exactly as on Wikipedia>": "<coupleId from data/season.json>". Only needed if automatic first-name matching flags a name.
_notes.excluded: Guest judge scores, bonus points (marathons, dance-offs) and team-dance tables are never counted. Withdrawals count as eliminations.
